title: Set up sensible safeguards for a first phone
intro: SafeWeb guides parents and caregivers through phone settings, encrypted DNS protection, and relevant service controls, then shows what is verified, confirmed, needs action, or is not covered.
accountless: You can start and complete the core setup without an account or payment card.
privacy: SafeWeb does not monitor messages, photos, contacts, location, or browsing history.
limitation: It helps reduce some risks, but it does not cover every app, connection, or behavior.
detailsBody: SafeWeb is not surveillance software. It does not read a child’s messages, inspect photos or contacts, track location, or create a browsing-history feed. Native controls, DNS filtering, and service settings each have limits, and the Protection Map keeps those limits visible.
